title: The Muster Roll
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.With the raiders unpaid, the Thak have pushed a second scout camp into the Boneyard. Its warden carries the army's muster roll.

About

Given bySergeant Idony Marsh
Level33
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Thak Muster Roll ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Sergeant Idony Marsh to get the quest.
  2. Kill 10 Thak Scouts (10)
  3. Kill Scout Warden Ushk at 853, 918
    Bring Sergeant Ottilie Hallam the muster roll - Thak Muster Roll at 1858, 120

Rewards

Reward
Quest points1

What Sergeant Idony Marsh says

Sergeant Ottilie Hallam: Marsh sent you? Let me see it.

Sergeant Ottilie Hallam: Companies, and the day each one marches. Every one of them is marching east, toward the Dune Sea.

Sergeant Ottilie Hallam: I'll have riders on the way to the Line tonight. Commander Harrow has to see this before they get there.

Sergeant Ottilie Hallam: Marsh would want you paid. Take a helm off the rack. For plate that's the plain full helm. The crested ones are for officers.

Handing it in
